title: Narrative Sprout
description: Create unique stories in a world of your own design. Set the theme for your story, and AI will bring it to life with dynamic narratives and visuals.
worldDescriptionLabel: Describe the theme of your story
worldDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g., A neon-lit cyberpunk city where it never stops raining
generateThemeTooltip: Generate a random theme idea with AI
a1111EndpointHelp: Ensure the server is running with CORS enabled (e.g., `--cors-allow-origins=*`).
a1111ConfigHelp: Specify the JSON object for the txt2img API. The 'prompt' in this object will be appended to the AI-generated prompt. Invalid JSON will be ignored and defaults used.
comfyuiEndpointHelp: e.g., http://127.0.0.1:8188. Ensure the server is running with CORS enabled (e.g., --enable-cors-header).
comfyuiWorkflowHelp: Paste your API-format workflow here. ##prompt## and ##negative_prompt## will be replaced. The number 1234567890 will be replaced with a random seed.
huggingFaceConfigHelp: Specify the JSON object for the Space's `/infer` API. 'prompt' will be appended to the AI-generated prompt. Keys with value "delete" will be removed. Invalid JSON is ignored.
huggingFaceSpaceIdHelp: Hugging Face Space ID for image generation (e.g., 'black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell')
huggingFaceTokenHelp: Optional. Required for private or gated Hugging Face Spaces.
refineScenePromptLabel: Describe what needs to be corrected and how. Be specific.
refineScenePlaceholder: e.g. "The response contains English text despite being set to Japanese. Rewrite all non-Japanese parts in Japanese."
redoSceneConfirmMessage: Do you want to discard the context so far? Discarding will lose story details but will reset any fixed writing style.
redoRootConfirmMessage: A new save slot will be created with a regenerated first scene. The current save will remain.
loadingResearching: Researching the world via Google Search...
errorApiOverloaded: Requests to the AI model are currently high. Please wait a moment and click 'Retry'.
errorApiGeneric: An error occurred while communicating with the AI. Please check your network connection and API key.
errorPromptBlocked: The story could not continue because the prompt was blocked. Please adjust the theme on the start screen.
errorEmptyResponse: The AI returned an empty response. This may be a temporary issue. Please try again.
errorInvalidJson: The AI seems confused and returned an invalid response. You can try asking it again.
apiKeyModalDescriptionShort: To begin your story, you need an OpenRouter API key.
apiKeyPkceDescription: To begin your story, you need an OpenRouter API key. We use OAuth PKCE to get the API key from OpenRouter. After signing into the OpenRouter site, please approve the API key issuance. The issued API key is securely stored in your browser's private file system.
apiKeyPkceSuccess: API key has been saved to your device.
sceneLengthHelp: Controls the approximate length of each scene description. Longer settings use more API credits and may take longer to generate.
memoryStrategyHelp: Controls how the story memory is updated. Single makes a single AI call per turn — cheaper and faster, but the same call also updates memory alongside the scene, so accuracy can suffer. Split adds a second, dedicated AI call focused purely on updating memory — more accurate, but it consumes extra tokens (and costs twice if you are billed per call). Auto picks between the two based on scene length.
deleteAllDataWarning: This will completely delete all save data, settings, and API keys. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAllDataConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete all save data and settings? This action cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this save data?
deleteBranchConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this story branch? This action cannot be undone.
historyScreenDescription: These are the various endings and branching points your story has reached. Choose one to view the story or resume play from that point.
chronicleDescription: The complete record of your story leading up to this point.
exportFailed: Failed to export story. Check console for details.
helpImageGenerator: Choose how game images are generated. You can use Google's powerful AI, connect to your own local image generation server, or disable images completely.
helpA1111Endpoint: Enter the full URL of your AUTOMATIC1111/Stable Diffusion Web UI server, including 'http://' or 'https://'. The server must be started with '--api' and have CORS enabled.
helpA1111Config: Specify preferred default parameters for the txt2img API in a JSON object. These settings (sampler, steps, etc.) will be merged with the AI-generated prompt.
helpComfyUIEndpoint: Enter the full URL of your ComfyUI server, including 'http://' or 'https://'. The server must be started with CORS enabled (e.g., '--enable-cors-header').
helpComfyUIWorkflow: Paste the 'API Format' JSON of your ComfyUI workflow. Placeholders ##prompt##, ##negative_prompt##, and seed number 1234567890 will be automatically replaced during generation.
helpHuggingFaceSpaceId: Specify the identifier for a public or private image generation Space on Hugging Face in the format 'organization/space-name' (e.g., 'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3-medium').
helpHuggingFaceToken: A Hugging Face User Access Token is required to use private or gated Spaces. You can get one from your Hugging Face account settings.
helpEditSceneText: Edit the scene text. If there are issues like typos in the AI-generated text, you can correct the text to prevent it from affecting the next scene generation.
helpHuggingFaceConfig: Specify default parameters for the Space's API in a JSON object. This is unique to each Space. Check the Space's API documentation for available options.
helpGoogleSearch: The AI will use Google Search on the first turn to gather the latest information based on the theme and add depth to the world view. Effective for stories based on recent events or real-world topics. Initial load time and API usage may increase slightly.
aiTranslationDescription: Translate the UI into any language using AI. Results are saved to your device. Note: Right-to-Left (RTL) language layouts are not currently supported.
aiTranslationError: AI translation failed. The model may have returned an invalid response, or the language may not be well-supported. Please try again.
modelToggleExpand: Click to show full model name
debugLogsEnableLabel: Enable debug logging in the browser console (Requires page reload)
googleDriveDescription: Sign in with your Google account to backup and restore save data. This will create an app-specific folder in your Google Drive. Only you and this app can access this folder; developers cannot. Do not share backup files with others as they contain your API key.
loadFromDriveConfirm: This will overwrite all current local data with the backup data from Google Drive. Are you sure you want to continue?
euDisclaimer: Stories in this app are generated by AI (e.g., Gemini). Inputs are processed on your device and are not sent to developer servers. AI responses may contain errors. this app does not use cookies. API keys are stored locally. See Terms and Privacy Policy for details.
googleDriveSaveError: Failed to save to Google Drive. Please try again.
googleDriveLoadError: Failed to load from Google Drive. Please try again.
googleSignInError: Google Sign-In failed. Please try again.
googleSignOutError: Google Sign-Out failed. Please try again.
deleteAllDataSuccess: All data on the device has been deleted. Please close this page.
downloadSavedataDescription: Download this save data in ZIP format. Please select the following options.
importSettingsConfirmMessage: This save data contains custom image generator settings (endpoint URLs or ComfyUI workflows) that could be unsafe if from an untrusted source. Do you want to clear these settings and use the default settings? (Choose 'Keep Settings (Advanced)' to keep the custom settings).
nimEndpointHelp: The full URL of the NIM inference endpoint, e.g. https://ai.api.nvidia.com/v1/genai/black-forest-labs/flux.2-klein-4b
helpNimEndpoint: Enter the full inference URL. The NVIDIA NIM hosted API does not support CORS in the browser, so you will need a CORS proxy or the Windows desktop app to use it.
nimTokenHelp: Optional. Your NGC API key if the NIM endpoint requires authentication.
helpNimToken: If hosted on NVIDIA's API (build.nvidia.com), use your NGC API key. For self-hosted NIM, a token may not be needed.
nimConfigHelp: Specify the JSON parameters for the NIM inference API. Common fields: seed, steps, width, height. Model-specific fields vary; unsupported fields cause errors.
helpNimConfig: Specify default parameters for the NIM inference API as a JSON object. These are merged with the AI-generated prompt. Check the model's API reference for supported parameters.
streamingDescription: Stream the story text live as it's generated. If the provider doesn't support streaming, it automatically falls back to bulk delivery.
streamingPerModelDisabled: Streaming is disabled for this model (--stream=false).
streamingUnsupportedForBaseURL: This endpoint was detected as not supporting streaming and will use bulk delivery.
streamingSupportedNote: This endpoint will try streaming and fall back automatically if unsupported.
streamingPerModelHelp: Add --stream=false to the model string to disable per-model (e.g., "provider/model --stream=false").
storyLogCompactionDescription: As your story grows, the internal scene log is periodically compressed into a concise chronicle to keep context within limits. This makes an extra, automatic archivist call that preserves plot-critical facts. Turn it off to keep the full log verbatim (may exceed the model's context on very long stories).
storyLogCompactionDisabled: Story log compaction is disabled. The full story log will be kept and sent each turn.
apiKeyResetAlert: The specifications of this app have changed. Therefore, we will temporarily delete the API key.
requireOpfsDescription: This browser does not implement the Origin private file system.
dividerWordsSoFar: This {{ordinal}} turn is {{words}} words so far.
loadingAutoplay: Autoplay is deciding the next action...
apiKeyStoredLocallyNote: The key is stored locally in the browser (IndexedDB credentials store) only. It is never included in exports or backups.
scenarioFileHelp: Scenario files (YAML front matter with a `theme:` key) set the theme; their body becomes attached world text. Text attachments support `{a|b}` random choices and `<flag:NAME>` conditional blocks.
deleteSaveConfirmMessage: Delete "{{title}}" and all of its scenes and images? This cannot be undone.
noImportableSaveData: No importable save data found in the file.
dataDeletionCompleteDescription: All save data, settings, and API keys have been removed from this browser.
backupRestoreDescription: Backups contain every save plus your non-secret settings, encrypted with AES-GCM (WebCrypto). API keys are never included. If you lose the passphrase, the backup cannot be restored.
noDriveBackupsYet: No backups found on Drive yet. "Back up to Drive" creates one.
invalidModelOption: Invalid model setting. Use "provider/model" with optional "--option=value" pairs.
apiKeyPrefixMismatchWarning: This key does not look like an OpenRouter key (expected prefix: sk-or-). Check the endpoint or the key.
apiKeyPkceFailed: Failed to get the API key from OpenRouter. Please try again.
